effect_description_eng: [When Moving] [On Play] You may suspend 1 Digimon. If this effect suspended your Digimon, 1 of your Digimon with [Avian] or [Bird] in any of its traits or the [Vortex Warriors] trait gets +3000 DP until your opponent's turn ends.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon wins a battle, gain 1 memory.
